name: infomaniak-ai
description: Inspect Infomaniak infrastructure through a small, read-only MCP gateway.

api_token.title: Infomaniak API token
api_token.description: An existing token for the read scopes you need. The gateway does not store it.

backend_path.title: Reviewed MCP server build
backend_path.description: Absolute path to the reviewed infomaniak-mcp-agent dist/server.js file.

backend_sha256.title: MCP build SHA-256
backend_sha256.description: Checksum of that exact build. Review changes before replacing this value.
